title: Write Your First Heading
hint: Use the <h1> tag to create a heading that says 'Hello World!'

correct.title: Excellent Work! 🎉
correct.details: You've successfully created your first HTML heading! The <h1> tag is one of the most important elements in HTML. It tells browsers and search engines what your page is about.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: Remember, you need to use the <h1> tag with the text 'Hello World!' inside. Make sure to include both the opening tag <h1> and closing tag </h1>.
